↳ Uses: online banking, digital signatures, secure emails, VPNs.

🔷PageRank ⭢ Calculates web page relevance by links.
↳ Uses: search engines, content ranking, web indexing, SEO tools.

🔷Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) ⭢ Processes image patterns for analysis.
↳ Uses: facial recognition, medical imaging, object detection, self-driving cars.

🔷Transformers ⭢ Powers advanced natural language models.
↳ Uses: AI chatbots, translations, text generation, sentiment analysis.

🔷Fast Fourier Transform ⭢ Analyzes signals by converting them to frequency domain.
↳ Uses: communication, audio processing, image compression, medical imaging.

🔷Dijkstra’s Algorithm ⭢ Determines shortest paths in networks.
↳ Uses: GPS systems, network routing, game development, logistics planning.

🔷Gradient Descent ⭢ Optimizes machine learning model performance.
↳ Uses: neural networks, AI training, data fitting, predictive analytics.

🔷Secure Hash Algorithms ⭢ Protects data integrity through hashing.
↳ Uses: password storage, blockchain, file verification, digital signatures.

Anthropic published their "Recommendations to OSTP for the U.S. AI Action Plan"

- Anthropic predicts powerful AI systems will appear by late 2026 or early 2027, with intellectual abilities matching Nobel Prize winners, able to autonomously handle digital tasks (text, audio, video, internet browsing), reason independently over hours or weeks, and control physical equipment digitally

- They recommend stronger national security actions, including government testing of AI models for security risks, stricter export controls on key chips like the H20, and secure communication channels between AI labs and intelligence agencies

- They suggest the government build 50 gigawatts of additional power capacity dedicated to AI by 2027, speed up AI adoption across federal agencies, and improve economic data collection to prepare for AI’s impact on jobs and society
